items.title: SKIFF: Container Manager for Zero Trust Environments
items.text: Open-source container manager built for GCP and zero-trust workstations. Avoids nested virtualization and privileged socket mounts. Talks to the daemon over SSH with nothing persistent on the container host. Four-tier test suite, 94% coverage floor, anti-pattern linter, and per-framework compliance evidence (OWASP ASVS, NIST SSDF, NIST CSF, SLSA, CIS Docker Benchmark). MIT-licensed.

items.text: MLX implementation of persisted 4-bit KV caches for multi-agent LLM inference on Apple Silicon, with background reloads and a demo app. Code for the Agent Memory Below the Prompt paper.

items.title: Neural DSP for Edge Deployment
items.text: Replacing traditional signal processing pipelines with learned models for embedded systems. Targeting Cortex-M class MCUs and small NPUs. Neurosymbolic approaches that preserve physics constraints while reducing compute by orders of magnitude.

items.title: Stateful Agent Architecture for Low-Latency Retrieval
items.text: Memory-safe context management for agentic workflows. Persistent state segmentation with retrieval from short contexts at low latency and low hallucination. Treats jailbreak detection as a buffer overflow problem.

items.title: Classical Baseline vs. RL: Franka Pick-and-Place in Isaac Sim
items.text: 150 lines of classical control logic for a Franka Panda doing randomized pick-and-place. No training, no reward function. The baseline tells you exactly where learning earns its complexity budget.
